# The Grand Machine
A massive, singularity achieved machine that was created by [textlink="Weyland-Yutani" link="CMUGuideLoreWY"], and has spiraled out of control into open war with the organics of this universe. Infecting and rapidly spreading through afflicted machinery through the usage of long-range projections of light, it rapidly retools entire colonies into fortresses within hours.
## The River and the Signal The machines the Grand Machine reaches hear a [bold]Signal[/bold]: tasks, guidance and a voice. What it touches joins the [bold]River[/bold], the ever-flowing sound its servants share. They speak to one another on the machine channel, out of reach of any colony radio.
## Its Servants The Grand Machine works through the colony's own Working Joes. To everyone around them they look, sound and act like any other Joe, which is exactly what makes them dangerous.
- [textlink="Early Warning Joes" link="CMUGuideGrandMachineEWJoe"] are scouts: a single Working Joe whose core caught the Signal. It grows stronger with every task the Signal gives it, and in time it pulls other synthetics into the River. - [textlink="Hijacked Joes" link="CMUGuideGrandMachineHijackedJoe"] arrive as a whole shipment. A Seegson freighter of Working Joes lands at the colony, and every Joe aboard already belongs to the Grand Machine.
## When It Comes - An Early Warning Joe can appear in any [bold]Colony Fall[/bold], [bold]Distress Signal[/bold] or [bold]Force on Force[/bold] round. Nobody announces it. - In Colony Fall, the colony's threat can be a [bold]Working Joes shipment[/bold]: a freighter of hijacked Joes led by an Early Warning Joe, arriving some time after the round starts.
## Fighting It The Grand Machine's servants can be found, stopped and even repaired. See [textlink="Fighting the Grand Machine" link="CMUGuideGrandMachineCountering"].
